name: Serbia

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, blue and white, with the coat of arms, a crowned white double-headed eagle on a red shield, placed towards the hoist.
flag.symbolism: Red, blue and white are pan-Slavic colours; the double-headed eagle comes from the medieval Nemanjić dynasty.

hook: Serbia is Russia's flag turned upside down, red-blue-white from the top, with a crowned white eagle near the flagpole.
trivia: Without the coat of arms, Serbia's civil flag is exactly Russia's flag upside down.
The coat of arms on the flag was redrawn in 2010.
